Grainy, high-contrast image emulating a 1960s film photograph with a direct flash. A young-adult-appearing man with light skin tone and curly, light-colored hair emerges from deep shadow beneath a wide-brimmed hat with starkly contrasting, saturated orange and white stripes on the crown and a red brim outlined in yellow. He wears a vertically divided tunic, the viewer's left side a saturated blue with a yellow sleeve, sharply contrasting with the saturated red and blue of the right side's tunic and sleeve. A yellow and blue belt encircles his shadowed waist. His legs are clad in saturated blue tights, and his shoes are red.

The man holds a thin, golden-yellow wand in his brightly lit, raised right hand, creating strong shadows. His left hand rests on a light brown wooden table standing on four legs. The table is partially illuminated, revealing a golden cup, a red cup, several golden coins, a knife with a black handle, and a white-handled knife. A pouch or bag sits nearby, partially obscured by shadow.

The background is swallowed by darkness, hinting at a light yellow ground and a darker yellow horizon line. A small green plant is barely visible in the shadows. A noticeable film grain permeates the image, and a slight vignette darkens the corners.
